correctness.rationale: For the stated Jordan–Wigner jumps and H=-J X_1X_2, direct Lindblad-adjoint evaluation gives two decoupled 2x2 damped Pauli systems and r′=-2(gamma_1+gamma_2)r. Since (z_1z_2+w_1w_2) obeys that same scalar equation and has the same initial value, r=z_1z_2+w_1w_2 for all t. Exact ordered-Majorana partial time reversal yields twisted spectral blocks with radicands A²=(1+r)²+(w_1-w_2)² and B²=(1-r)²+(w_1+w_2)². Their squared difference 4z_1z_2 proves top-singular-gap degeneracy exactly iff z_1z_2=0; no accidental tie occurs away from zeros. Explicit elementary 2x2 propagators give oscillatory first-zero times, one critical polynomial zero, a unique hyperbolic zero for the higher-rate site, and no finite zero for the lower-rate site at or above contrast 4J. The resulting arccos/arccosh formula and strict monotonicity follow analytically. The packaged symbolic script passed exact closure, characteristic-polynomial and invariant-identity assertions; the packaged direct 16x16 Liouvillian script returned VERIFY_OK 1521. Numeric tests are corroborative, not proofs of the infinite-time or all-rate assertions.

value.rationale: Sitewise particle-hole balance is a physically meaningful condition distinct from spatially uniform bath strength. The recent Gaussian criticality theorem gives fixed clocks for uniform balanced noise, raising the natural question whether independent local balancing suffices. The exact answer is a sharp negative: every nonzero site-rate difference splits two formerly coincident clocks, contrast exactly 4J extinguishes the later finite crossing, and the earlier twisted-negativity gap persists at a strictly earlier analytically determined time at every finite contrast. The mean bath strength cancels from the entire first-clock law. This is a complete natural minimal-model classification, not a marginal numeric gain or a generic linear ODE exercise; the fermionic spectral proof and transition identify physically meaningful observables and a sharp boundary.
